title: Compass and Clock
author: Bram Dunmore
blurb: Wendell Eriksen, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
